gen-dafont-neon-gf-esteban: Neon glows with a stamped-metal swagger, every line drawn at a single width. Esteban follows in a classic serif whose hairlines run only slightly thinner than its stems, and its oversized lowercase keeps things friendly.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-faustina: Faustina reads with a gentle, authoritative modulation in its bowls. Under Neon's rod-like letters, a whole page of it would feel steady and warm, like a pleasant stroll after a buzzing sign.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-halant: Bent tubing meets sturdy type. Neon's wiry, glowing letters feel lit from within, while Halant's towering x-height and outward-pointing terminals give the pair a traditional, grounded backbone.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-headland-one: Neon lights up the top with bowls that never thin at the sides, like glowing wire. Headland One then spreads its serif letters well apart, giving a long page a lightly shaded texture and a dignified pace.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-hedvig-letters-serif: Hedvig Letters Serif reads sturdy and classic, its curves staying open with room to breathe and its contrast kept moderate. Neon's plain, unmodulated outline is what makes that quiet shading stand out.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-lisu-bosa: Vibrant and wire-bent, Neon looks like a sign. Lisu Bosa is the real draw, a text serif with spilling counters and sturdy, large lowercase that make its faint nib-pressure variation feel unmistakably editorial.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-montagu-slab: Monoline strokes make Neon glow like a sign tube, one line width from start to finish. And Montagu Slab keeps a long page easy going, with robust downstrokes, slender turns and a sizable x-height.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-serif-hentaigana: Noto Serif Hentaigana reads in a refined, classic serif, with open jaws on its curves and hairlines present but never razor thin. Neon glides like wire; the body type settles in to carry the words.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-ovo: Ovo is a classic serif with a gentle thick-to-thin shift. Its tall middle band and shallow ascenders and descenders make long paragraphs feel compact and authoritative, while Neon's stroke-free w glows above.
gen-dafont-neuropol-gf-bhutuka-expanded-: BhuTuka Expanded One reads slowly, at a leisurely walk. Neuropol's closed, outlined letters give a futuristic jolt, and the curvy, open serif below loosens everything up again.
